title: Developer settings
purpose: Create, roll and revoke API keys, manage webhooks and connect integrations without treating them as ordinary forms.
useWhen: A product exposes API keys, webhooks or third-party integrations to its customers.
avoidWhen: Personal access tokens for the product's own sign-in; use the auth contract and SecretField.
alternatives: Use the settings contract for ordinary preferences, and SecretField alone for one stored secret.
requiredInputs: keys with name, masked tail and last use
a create adapter returning the secret once
roll and revoke adapters with the roll's overlap window
webhook endpoints, events, deliveries and retry and test adapters
integrations with OAuth start and completion
transitions: key-creating → secret-shown → secret-acknowledged before the dialog can close
rolling → the new key, with the old one working for the overlap
delivery-failed → delivery-retrying → delivered or failed with its attempt
oauth-pending → connected, or back to Connect when abandoned
applicability: Developer areas with API keys, webhooks and integrations.
exceptions: Require only the parts the product offers; products that allow revealing a stored secret must still mask it by default.
